QuestInfo.name: Chewy Rice Cake Stick
QuestInfo.0: #bCassandra#k says she'll share a tasty secret with you. Talk to Cassandra.
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra says she's been craving a warm, crispy baked Rice Cake Stick since the weather has been so cold. She says although Rice Cake Sticks are tasty when eaten as-is, they are even tastier if you dip them in honey.  She says she'll bake you a Rice Cake Stick if you bring a #b#t4032909##k and a #b#t4032910##k from monsters.
QuestInfo.2: Cassandra says she's been craving a warm, crispy baked Rice Cake Stick since the weather has been so cold. 0.0: Ah, it's fall. And soon, it will be winter. When the weather starts getting cold like this, there is nothing better than a baked Rice Cake Stick dipped in honey to soothe your soul. Doesn't that sound good?

no.0: But you'll fall in love with it once you try it!

1.0: Wow, that was fast! You must have been dying to try it. Give me a second!

yes.0: Here you go! Isn't it perfectly crispy? If you want more, come back in 2 hours.
